operation_details.item: The user uses Notion for article outlines.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How do you organize a writing project from the initial idea through revisions?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Notion for my article outlines.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Once an outline is ready, what do you use to develop a longer draft?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Scrivener for long-form drafts.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How do you handle revisions when other people need to contribute comments or edits?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Google Docs for collaborative edits.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What helps you keep the voice and formatting consistent across different assignments?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I keep a shared style guide for all projects.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives your workflow clear stages for planning, drafting, collaboration, and consistency.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I prefer keeping those stages distinct so each tool has a focused role.
